mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scene_videos ( scene_id, asset_id, thumbnail_asset_id, merge_signature, status, duration_ms, thumbnail_url, is_active ) VALUES ( #{sceneId}, #{assetId}, #{thumbnailAssetId}, #{mergeSignature}, #{status}, #{durationMs}, #{thumbnailUrl}, 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT id, scene_id, asset_id, thumbnail_asset_id, merge_signature, status, duration_ms, thumbnail_url, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM scene_videos WHERE scene_id = #{sceneId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, scene_id, asset_id, thumbnail_asset_id, merge_signature, status, duration_ms, thumbnail_url, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM scene_videos WHERE scene_id = #{sceneId} AND is_active = 1 AND merge_signature = #{mergeSignature} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, scene_id, asset_id, thumbnail_asset_id, merge_signature, status, duration_ms, thumbnail_url, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM scene_videos WHERE scene_id = #{sceneId} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE scene_videos SET asset_id = #{assetId}, thumbnail_asset_id = #{thumbnailAssetId}, status = #{status}, thumbnail_url = #{thumbnailUrl}, duration_ms = #{durationMs} WHERE id = #{id}
